task: Fully remove the ZephyrSquad credential type and tool integration from the platform, including the associated database enum value and stored settings rows.

key_reasoning.reason: Removal spans the QA toolkit (zephyr_squad module deleted entirely: __init__, api_wrapper, models, tools, tools_vars), the settings service layer (settings.py, settings_request_validator.py, settings_tester.py), two REST routers (project_settings.py, user_settings.py), and the shared CredentialTypes enum in codemie_tools/base/models.py — 4+ components across multiple subsystems.

The alembic migration (d9e8f7a6b5c4) issues a hard DELETE FROM codemie.settings WHERE credential_type = 'ZEPHYR_SQUAD' before dropping the enum label; the downgrade path restores the enum value but not the deleted rows, making the data loss irreversible even though the change itself follows an established enum-cleanup pattern and was pre-confirmed by the product owner as zero-usage.
diffstat reports 23 files changed (439 insertions, 823 deletions) — comfortably in the 16+ file XXL band, though the heavy deletion bias reflects removal work rather than new-code complexity.

Touches Agent-Tool (qa toolkit), Service (settings/validator/tester), API (two routers), and DB-Persistence (alembic migration + enum definition) — 4 distinct layers, with an actual schema-changing migration.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from L to XL: touches a core shared utility (CredentialTypes enum consumed by settings service, validator, tester, and tool configs)
